nodes.label: Official DF11 compressor (compress_model)
nodes.rationale: Slow because of an interpreted per-symbol Python loop, not the GIL; high RAM because the whole model is instantiated plus large per-UC temporaries.

nodes.rationale: Format not DF11-compatible; reused streaming reader idea, vectorised-encoding identity testing, and methodological discipline.

nodes.norm_label: official pre-compressed df11 releases as reference output
nodes.rationale: Byte identity needs the official output, not the compressor; reading published files streams in a few hundred MB instead of ~64 GB.

nodes.label: Tied embedding / lm_head duplication
nodes.rationale: Deduplicating would halve work but break byte identity since the official tool emits both; detect and report only, opt-in later.

nodes.label: Rust as implementation language
nodes.rationale: Equal to C on speed; wins via reference safetensors crate, rayon, single static binary for old machines, and memory safety in bit manipulation.

nodes.label: get_luts carry-forward LUT leak bug
nodes.rationale: Accumulator is function-scoped, so prefix tables without key 0 inherit the previous table's trailing value; reproduced by default because a correct LUT would fail byte-identity against every real DF11 file.

nodes.rationale: Not redistributed by df11pack.

nodes.label: FINDINGS.md (df11pack measurement log)
nodes.rationale: Predictions recorded before measurement and never edited; errata stated explicitly rather than rewriting history.

nodes.label: Byte-identity is the contract
nodes.rationale: Default output must stay byte-identical to the official compressor; anything else opt-in and marked.

nodes.label: Tests must be able to fail
nodes.norm_label: tests must be able to fail

nodes.label: Cross-platform test matrix (Linux/Windows/macOS)
nodes.rationale: Byte-identity tests SKIP without Phase 0 fixtures; everything else runs in CI.

nodes.label: cupy stub (phase0/shim/cupy.py)
nodes.rationale: Makes dfloat11 importable without GPU and proves a compression run never touched the GPU.

nodes.label: Pinned versions (dahuffman 0.4.2, dfloat11 0.5.0, numpy 2.5.3)
nodes.rationale: Different dahuffman/dfloat11 versions silently change what byte-identical means.

nodes.label: decode.cu / decode.ptx kernel
nodes.rationale: Ground truth of the format; three phases: counting, Blelloch prefix sum, decode-and-write. Not redistributed (MIT licence decision).

nodes.label: Chunked parallel encoder (histogram prefix-sum)
nodes.rationale: Per-chunk histograms give each chunk's bit offset for free; the kernel's trick in reverse. No per-symbol offset array is materialised.

nodes.label: Parallel CPU reference decoder
nodes.rationale: Independent of the encoder so bugs cannot self-confirm; mirrors kernel window structure so errors localise.

nodes.label: H12: CPU decoder scales with cores
nodes.norm_label: h12: cpu decoder scales with cores

nodes.label: Swappable index component (df11 / idx8)
nodes.rationale: Costs nothing now and makes future index schemes additive rather than a rewrite; does not imply idx8 will be built.

nodes.label: Compression/decompression asymmetry
nodes.rationale: Compression is a serial CPU loop while decompression is massively parallel on GPU; the metadata enabling parallel decode already exists, so the encoder can exploit it.

nodes.label: MIT licence decision
nodes.rationale: Replicating the Apache-2.0 format is compatible with any permissive licence; decode.ptx is not redistributed.

nodes.label: Flux/Chroma diffusers concatenation orders
nodes.rationale: Order determines split_positions and every compressed byte; guessed orders would be byte-wrong.

nodes.label: dfloat11_config.pattern_dict
nodes.rationale: Per-model choice, not an architecture constant; published releases are ground truth.

nodes.label: Tier-0 corpus qwen3-trunc
nodes.rationale: Truncated to 4 layers but layer unit same size as full model so per-unit memory behaviour is identical.

nodes.label: Layers-only pattern (Qwen3-4B style)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for tier 1 because the largest unit is 15.7M weights so the official compressor fits in ~2 GiB RAM.

nodes.label: Mainstream pattern (lm_head + embed_tokens standalone)
nodes.rationale: Used by all DF11 LLMs >=8B; 155.6M-weight units would not fit the official compressor on 3 GB.

nodes.label: Standalone single-tensor unit (empty attr_names)
nodes.rationale: Mainstream, not an edge case; must be first-class in Phase 1 with empty split_positions.

nodes.norm_label: h11: loader dispatches by tensor name, not shard layout

nodes.norm_label: h6: physical tensor order structurally confirmed

nodes.norm_label: tied lm_head compressed as own unit

nodes.label: TOML model definition format
nodes.rationale: The pattern_dict plus provenance; source field required because a definition without provenance is a guess.

nodes.label: H8: non-unit tensors passed through untouched (LLM)
nodes.norm_label: h8: non-unit tensors passed through untouched (llm)

nodes.label: idx8 index scheme with escape table
nodes.norm_label: idx8 index scheme with escape table
nodes.rationale: Saves 0.6-1.3% of output but is not DFloat11; escape table chosen because plain idx8 overflows on real Qwen3-0.6B layers.

nodes.label: INV-OUTPOS-DELTA invariant
nodes.rationale: Added after a corruption passed the original ten invariants; monotonicity alone is drastically weaker.

nodes.label: Format divergence requires own decoder and name
nodes.norm_label: format divergence requires own decoder and name

nodes.label: IndexBuilder seam
nodes.rationale: Encoder already computes chunk bit lengths/offsets; keeping index generation behind an interface costs nothing now and is expensive to retrofit.

nodes.label: Checkpoints, journal and resume (dropped)
nodes.rationale: Per-UC checkpoint as idempotent unit; later dropped in favour of atomic output once compression became fast.

nodes.label: Chroma architecture
nodes.rationale: Flux minus modulation linears plus the ChromaApproximator; ~8.9B params based on FLUX.1-schnell.

nodes.label: ChromaApproximator (distilled_guidance_layer)
nodes.rationale: In diffusers it is one unit of 12 including in_proj/out_proj; only RMSNorms stay uncompressed (H13 refuted).

nodes.label: Compression unit (UC)
nodes.rationale: UCs are fully independent (own codebook, LUTs, indices), so parallelising across UCs has no conceptual barrier.

nodes.label: pattern_dict
nodes.rationale: attr_names order fixes concatenation, hence split_positions and every compressed byte.

nodes.label: Architecture definitions as TOML data
nodes.rationale: Adding models should not require recompiling.

nodes.label: Atomic output (Phase 4 revised)
nodes.rationale: Compression became fast (Qwen3-0.6B 10.7 s, Flux ~5 min), so resume/journal cost more than they protect; what remains is that a half-written file must never look finished: .tmp, fsync, rename, dir fsync.

nodes.label: Two-pass single-file writer (StreamingWriter)
nodes.rationale: Avoids holding all units in memory or doubling disk; costs double CPU.

nodes.label: np.argpartition tie order (load-bearing)
nodes.rationale: Decisive at 32-bit limiter with boundary value >1; must pin numpy 2.5.3.

nodes.label: get_luts curr_val carry-over bug
nodes.rationale: Byte-identity requires reproducing the bug; leaked positions proven unreachable, so --luts=correct is releasable.

nodes.label: safetensors library layout order (dtype then name)
nodes.norm_label: safetensors library layout order (dtype then name)

nodes.label: Byte-identity criterion
nodes.rationale: Only comparing bytes against real outputs catches bugs like the get_luts leak; later erratum: held for tensors, not whole files until headers fixed.

nodes.label: dahuffman representative-based tie-break rule
nodes.rationale: Total order, portable to Rust without Python heapq.

nodes.label: BYTES_PER_WEIGHT_HELD constant
nodes.rationale: Measured 3.7-5.7; set to 6.0 so budget errs toward fewer workers.

nodes.label: Per-definition key rules (strip_prefix, drop, rename)
nodes.rationale: Per definition, not global: Krea-2 keeps .scale tensors.

nodes.label: Definitions against real checkpoints (23 of 28 fit)
nodes.norm_label: definitions against real checkpoints (23 of 28 fit)

nodes.label: Tied word embeddings (lm_head / embed_tokens)
nodes.rationale: Breaks single-file mode; lm_head dropped from directory output and must be reconstructed; OmniGen2 release compresses shared weight twice.

nodes.label: H10: config.json rebuildable without heavy libs
nodes.norm_label: h10: config.json rebuildable without heavy libs

nodes.label: Transformers-version RoPE config trap
nodes.rationale: Justifies ConfigMode::PreserveSource over matching save_pretrained bytes.

nodes.label: Determinism baseline for logits comparison
nodes.rationale: A comparison without a baseline cannot tell different from nondeterministic.

nodes.label: Two-sided output_positions chunk bound
nodes.rationale: Monotonicity alone missed an adversarial corruption; bound from min/max code length.

nodes.label: H4: reproduce dahuffman codebook from histogram
nodes.norm_label: h4: reproduce dahuffman codebook from histogram

nodes.label: 32-bit limiter: refuse on ambiguous tie (AmbiguousLimiterTie)
nodes.rationale: argpartition tie order is unspecified; reimplementing NumPy introselect would pin one NumPy version forever, so df11pack is either byte-identical or refuses.

nodes.label: LUT carry-forward leakage
nodes.rationale: Official get_luts leaks the previous table's trailing value; byte identity requires reproducing it (--luts=compat default, --luts=correct gated).

nodes.label: Hierarchical LUTs (>=240 jump convention)
nodes.rationale: Jump values 240..255 bound prefix tables at 17 and forbid real exponents 240-255.

nodes.label: EOF window gaps bug in chunked encoder
nodes.norm_label: eof window gaps bug in chunked encoder

nodes.label: gaps index tensor
nodes.rationale: 5 bits per 64-bit window, 1.91% of unit; the only index tensor worth a design decision.

nodes.label: idx8 escape table
nodes.rationale: Block 32 costs more than DF11 gaps; escapes keep block 64 viable (0.64% of unit).

nodes.label: Intra-unit parallelism
nodes.rationale: Lifts ceiling for models with few large units; peak speed at 8 workers with 44% less memory.

nodes.label: df11pack compressor
nodes.rationale: Independent fast DFloat11 compressor: no GPU, no Python, byte-identical output so existing loaders work unchanged.

nodes.label: Diffusers layout
nodes.rationale: One shard per UC plus remaining params and config.json with dfloat11_config; bitstream not interchangeable with ComfyUI layout due to different concatenation.

nodes.label: H5: native encoder is disk-bound
nodes.rationale: If the native encoder beats disk read speed, GPU encoding adds nothing but transfers, power and an NVIDIA dependency.

nodes.label: I/O scheduling (HDD vs SSD)
nodes.rationale: Single sequential reader on HDD to avoid seeks; concurrent readers on SSD.

nodes.label: RAM budget per worker (~1.35 N bytes)
nodes.norm_label: ram budget per worker (~1.35 n bytes)
nodes.rationale: Workers = min(cores, budget / (1.35 x N_max)); page cache for source data is not counted as own memory.

nodes.label: Streaming pipeline (reader, bounded queue, workers, committer)
nodes.norm_label: streaming pipeline (reader, bounded queue, workers, committer)

nodes.label: 3 GB RAM development machine constraint
nodes.rationale: Treated as the target environment so the low-RAM guiding principle is tested continuously; it constrains only running the official compressor for fixtures.

nodes.label: H8/H9: uncompressed tensors unchanged
nodes.rationale: Critical because the official tool works on the instantiated model while df11pack works on the file.

nodes.label: Qwen3-8B benchmark (40 s / 6.6 GB vs 37 min / 27.3 GB)
nodes.norm_label: qwen3-8b benchmark (40 s / 6.6 gb vs 37 min / 27.3 gb)

nodes.label: df11pack verify command (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Integrity level became structure-only after the journal was dropped, so a flipped value in a well-formed unit is invisible without the source.

nodes.label: Stratified chunk sampling
nodes.rationale: Uniform sampling catches systematic errors but not isolated ones; boundary chunks concentrate errors, and a seed makes runs reproducible.
